source: NYC Open Data, DOB NOW: Build - Job Application Filings, resource w9ak-ipjd, SODA API aggregate queries via the web-fetch tool
lead_definition: calendar days from filing_date to approved_date among filings with an approved_date (pending filings are excluded, so long leads are under-represented)
queries: count(*) where date_diff_d(approved_date,filing_date)<=K grouped by job_type, K in {7,30,90,180,365}; approved counts by job_type: count(approved_date) grouped by job_type. Consistency check: grouped counts sum to the ungrouped totals 518722 (<=7) and 683991 (<=30).
caveat: approved_date is plan approval in a municipal system; it is a proxy for an authority response time, not a project-specific consent. Grant/denial probabilities are not identified by these aggregates.
